title: Locally constant sheaf on the pro-etale site
statement:
Let $Y$ be a scheme and $A$ a commutative ring. Work on the small pro-étale site $Y_{\mathrm{proet}}$ with the universe and size conventions of [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site]. Let $A_Y$ be the constant sheaf of rings [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf]. Sheaves of $A_Y$-modules and their isomorphisms mean those of [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category].

For an $A$-module $M$, the *constant module sheaf* $\underline M_Y$ is the constant sheaf [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf], with values in $A$-modules, namely the sheafification [def-weil-pbc-sheafification] of the presheaf $U\mapsto M$ whose restriction maps are identities. Its $A_Y$-action is induced by the scalar multiplication $A\times M\to M$: locally represented constant sections $a,m$ have product represented by $am$.

A sheaf $\mathcal F$ of $A_Y$-modules is *constant* if there exist an $A$-module $M$ and an isomorphism of $A_Y$-module sheaves $\mathcal F\simeq\underline M_Y$. It is *locally constant* if there is a covering family $\{U_j\to Y\}_{j\in J}$ in $Y_{\mathrm{proet}}$ and, for each $j$, an $A$-module $M_j$ and an isomorphism of module sheaves
$$
 \mathcal F|_{U_j}\simeq\underline{M_j}_{U_j}.
$$
Here restriction is the restriction to the localized ringed site of [def-pur-localized-ringed-site]: $(\mathcal F|_{U_j})(V\to U_j)=\mathcal F(V\to Y)$, with coefficient ring $A_Y|_{U_j}$. The constant module sheaf $\underline{M_j}_{U_j}$ is formed on this localized ringed site by the same sheafification construction, using the restricted constant ring sheaf $A_Y|_{U_j}$ and the $A$-module $M_j$. The modules $M_j$ may vary with $j$; no finiteness condition on $A$ or on any $M_j$ is imposed.
